dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Is your dad a driver, too?
dialogue.reading: ɪz jʊr ˈdæd ə ˈdraɪvər, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No, he's retired. My brother is a mechanic.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, hiːz rɪˈtaɪərd. maɪ ˈbrʌðər ɪz ə məˈkænɪk.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Very busy! And my sister is a writer.
dialogue.reading: ˈvɛri ˈbɪzi! ənd maɪ ˈsɪstər ɪz ə ˈraɪtər.
